summary: Iteration 3 testing of The Alchemical Lexicon covering three new features (Monster Bestiary save, expanded Root Journeys to 4 roots, Trial Rewards badge) plus regression. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass. Added new tests: root_journeys ids == [oikos,morph,chron,graph] each with 3 frames; trial_badge is a URL string on GET /api/lexicon; POST /api/monsters + GET /api/monsters/QA_SESS_1 with upsert (no duplicate on same monster_id, second POST updates fields). Frontend: (1) Root Archaeology tab renders FOUR journeys (root-frame-image-oikos, root-frame-image-morphe, root-frame-image-khronos, root-frame-image-graphein all present); scoping via nearest ancestor of each card, the graph journey advances via its own root-next-button graphein -> photograph -> autograph, all rendered. (2) Monster Bestiary save flow — on Form & Change constellation, chron+morph then Spark opens rogue modal. save-monster-button is initially DISABLED (has disabled attribute), illustrate-monster-button triggers a real Gemini call (~10s) after which save-monster-button becomes enabled; clicking it swaps to monster-saved-badge. On Bestiary tab, bestiary-rogue-section renders and shows bestiary-monster-monster-chronmorph. After full page reload the saved monster persists (backend list returns it). (3) Trial Rewards — clicking the correct option for all 5 trials (t-vents=o3, t-noble=o1, t-oikos=o2, t-far=o2, t-meta=o1) reveals trials-reward-badge with brass badge image + 'Master Alchemist' text; badge persists after switching tabs and returning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is used in monster_art exception handler but declared AFTER app config (line 237). It still works because Python resolves names at call time, but this remains a latent order-of-declaration smell — carry-over from iter 2.
SparkVignette: still no user-facing error toast if /api/monster-art fails (500) — spinner just stops. Would leave user unable to save monster. Consider a small error state.

Trials.jsx / Bestiary.jsx / SparkVignette.jsx / RootArchaeology.jsx: naming inconsistency — trial answer options use `trials-option-*` while the request/prev-iteration selector docs use `trial-option-*`. Not a bug (options render fine), but worth aligning testid style across components for future testing playbooks.
seed_data_creation: QA_SESS_1 session saved to `saved_monsters` collection (monster-qa) and a real user-session UUID has one Chronmorph monster with a real Gemini-generated data-URL image. Harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trial answer option data-testid is `trials-option-<trialId>-<optId>` (NOT trial-option-*). Correct answers: t-vents=o3, t-noble=o1, t-oikos=o2, t-far=o2, t-meta=o1. Root Archaeology cards have no per-journey wrapper testid; scope by walking ancestors of `root-frame-image-<id>` to find the sibling `root-next-button`. Illustrate + save flow takes ~10s (Gemini image). Nav tab clicks occasionally flaky with Playwright actionability — using page.evaluate to click the button (or force=True) works reliably. The intro modal 'Enter the Laboratory' must be dismissed before any nav clicks.
